dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: Something's wrong.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: It actually lit up again... There has to be something wrong!

dialogue.name: Black
dialogue.speech: You relit the lighter, didn't you?

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: No way! You b*stard! What the hell are you doing?!

dialogue.name: Black
dialogue.speech: This soul...

dialogue.name: Black
dialogue.speech: did not belong to one who should be chosen.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: One who should be chosen?

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: H-Hey, are you...

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: He's dead. He's uninjured, but he's dead...

dialogue.name: Black
dialogue.speech: You relit the lighter, too, didn't you?

dialogue.name: Black
dialogue.speech: I'll give you one more chance. You have two possible paths...

dialogue.name: Girono
dialogue.speech: So it indiscriminately attacks anyone who happens to see the lighter relit.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: Th-This is...

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: This b*stard... He's dragging my soul

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: out of me through my shadow!

dialogue.name: Black
dialogue.speech: I'll give you one more chance. You have two possible paths...

dialogue.name: Black
dialogue.speech: The first path is to become a chosen one.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: It's no use... It's stronger than Golden Wind.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: The old man died after his soul was struck by that arrow.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: So what's going to happen to me

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: if my Stand is attacked?

dialogue.name: Black
dialogue.speech: Your only other path is death.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: Th-This arrow...

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: If I actually get stabbed by that arrow, I'm dead for sure!

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: I've got no choice!

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: Even if Polpo is one of the capos,

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: if he's going to stand in my way

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: and even k*ll an innocent old man like he was a piece of trash...

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: I have to defeat him!

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: Useless! Useless! Useless! Useless!

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: Golden Wind...

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Only your senses will go berserk, and all movements will look slow.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: It's gone! That's impossible!

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: It shouldn't be able to control its own movements right now.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: Even if it were able to move, it should be extremely slow.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: It shouldn't be able to disappear!

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: It has to be around here somewhere...

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: It has to be!

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: I have to find it before the slowed-time effect wears off,

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: or it'll attack me again.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: What?!

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: F-From within the shadows?! Sh-sh*t!

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: Its movements are slower, but it's still just as powerful!

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: I can't move at all!

dialogue.name: Girono
dialogue.speech: The shadows! It's in the shadows!

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: It can only move within the shadows, but at amazing speed...

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: Looks like it can't follow me into the sunlight.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: But the sun's going to set on the other side of the school soon.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: Once that happens, I'll have nowhere to run.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: What'll happen if I force it out into the sunlight?

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: It's definitely worth trying.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: But how am I going to drag it out?

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: What should I do? It's waiting right there.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: It's waiting there patiently

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: for the sun to go down.

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: Hey!

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: What are you doing, Giorno Giovanna?!

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: Koichi!

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: Who's that guy collapsed at the bottom of the stairs?!

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: What did you do to him?!

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: Hey, don't get the wrong idea!

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: That wasn't me!

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: That Stand right there atta—

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: The wrong idea?

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: I saw you talking to that old man!

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: I was watching from the window!

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: You were... watching?

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: Then... did you see the lighter being relit, too?

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: Huh?

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: Don't step into the handrail's shadow, Koichi!

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: Get out of the shadows!

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: Sh-sh*t!

dialogue.name: Black
dialogue.speech: You saw the lighter being relit, didn't you?

dialogue.name: Black
dialogue.speech: You have two possible paths.

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: Wh-What's going on?

dialogue.name: Black
dialogue.speech: The first path is to become a chosen one.

dialogue.name: Black
dialogue.speech: Your only other path is death.

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: This arrow is...

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: Golden Wind!

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: It hurts so much...

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: This hurts like hell, but now...

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: it looks like I was able to drag you out into the sunlight.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: I turned part of the handrail

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: into morning glories and let them hang down.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: Now you're out of the handrail's shadow!

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: So close!

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: There were more shadows nearby, so it managed to escape.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: But it looks like if I can drag that thing completely out into the sunlight,

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: I might be able to win.

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: Wh-What was...

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: What was that Stand?!

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: As you saw, it's trying to attack us.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: The old man who relit this lighter was k*lled.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: Because we saw it being relit,

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: both you and I are now its targets.

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: That's not what I meant.

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: That arrow... It's from the Bow and Arrow!

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: I didn't know one was in Italy, too...

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: What are you doing, Giorno Giovanna?!

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: Is it because of you that another Stand with the arrow appeared?!

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: It'll take too long to explain everything...

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: But I don't know anything.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: Do you know something about that Stand?

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: And about that arrow?

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: Why did you save me?

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: Telling me about that arrow is more important!

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: The sun's going to set!

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: Why did you save me?!

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: Don't you dare assume that I feel like I owe a thief like you anything!

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: The lighter being lit is because of something I did.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: There was nothing I could've done for that old man.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: I feel awful about it.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: I believe what I did was right, but I feel dark and gross inside.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: But despite that,

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: I, Giorno Giovanna, have a dream that I believe to be right.

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: Two years ago, I was shot with a similar arrow and gained my Stand ability.

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: If the person shot with the arrow doesn't awaken to that ability, they will die.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: Awaken to the ability?

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: That's it!

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: That's what it meant by the "chosen one"!

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: Someone whose Stand awakened!

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: And that must be the motive behind Polpo's test!

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: I don't know about the origin of the arrow,

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: but I've met a Stand very similar to this one before.

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: It's a long-distance remote-controlled Stand!

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: Long-distance and remote-controlled?

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: It can only carry out simple commands,

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: but it won't stop attacking until it's fulfilled its motive.

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: Our best option is to find the Stand user and take them down.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: Sadly, that's not an option.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: The user is in a jail cell. We can't get to him.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: Anyway,

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: that thing won't be able to leave the school building's shadow,

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: so let's head into the sunlight while it's still available.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: Then, before the sun goes down,

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: we'll lure it into the shadow of something that can move,

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: and then we'll get rid of that shadow.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: That way, we can drag it into the sunlight.

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: Got it!

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: I-It's gone!

dialogue.name: Black
dialogue.speech: I've got you!

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: Wh-What?!

dialogue.name: Black
dialogue.speech: You saw the lighter being relit, didn't you?

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: The crows!

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: It hid in the shadows of those crows and moved over there in them!

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: Th-This thing...

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: It's useless!

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: Sh-sh*t!

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: While in the shadows, its power and speed are much higher!

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: Act ! Freeze!

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: My Reverb Act 's ability is to make Stands or people heavier.

dialogue.name: Reverb
dialogue.speech: I've made its hands heavier,

dialogue.name: Reverb
dialogue.speech: so much that it won't be able to lift a finger from the ground.

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: It should let go.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: I made the entirety of its hands heavier!

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: It shouldn't be able to bend its fingers anymore!

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: It's strong...

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: It's determined to not let go, no matter what.

dialogue.name: Black
dialogue.speech: You have two possible paths...

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: I-It's no use!

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: Any damage inflicted upon the Stand goes right back to the user!

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: At this rate, Giorno's legs are going to break!

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: Act ! Undo Freeze...

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: No.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: Don't do that, Koichi.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: This ability that makes things heavier... Don't you dare undo it.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: This is perfect.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: This is exactly the ability that I was looking for!

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: But your leg's going to shatter!

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: Wh-What?

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: That tree...

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: Golden Wind is an ability that continuously gives life,

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: so that tree continued to grow, lived the extent of its life,

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: and is now starting to wither.

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: Ability?

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: But that tree's at least ten meters away...

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: So you got to the tree's roots by digging that hole!

dialogue.name: Bam,Sfx
dialogue.speech: Bam

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: Y-You did it! The shadow's gone!

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: It's been dragged out into the daylight!

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: You told me there were two paths,

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: but sadly, you only have one.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: Koichi, could you move to the right a little?

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: Huh? Like this?

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: Hmm...

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: Useless! Useless! Useless! Useless!

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: Bask in the sunlight.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: That's it.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: That's your one possible path.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: Still, I have to wonder

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: if I'm going to be able to join the g*ng now.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: What to do...

dialogue.name: Sign
dialogue.speech: Polpo

dialogue.name: Sign
dialogue.speech: Shadow Sabbath

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: That arrow...

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: The fact that the Arrow is also in Italy means

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: that there'll be even more victims!

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: I need to hurry up and tell Jotaro!

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: Wh-What are you doing?

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: Did you just say there'll be more?

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: We defeated Polpo's Stand,which had the arrow.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: You saw it for yourself.

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: Defeated? You've got this all wrong!

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: I'll admit that we managed to escape its attacks because of you,

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: but that Stand only stopped attacking because of the sunlight.

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: The user isn't hurt at all. They're perfectly fine!

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: So Polpo's alive?

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: Not only that, but long-distance remote-controlled Stands

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: basically don't affect their users at all.

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: He probably hasn't even realized there's been a battle here.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: What?

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: So he has no idea at all?

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: He doesn't know I'm a Stand user, either?

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: Chill out, would you?

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: If he noticed anything, it was probably that his hand felt a bit heavier,

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: but he'd have no way of knowing that you and I are Stand users.

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: Hey, could you move your finger?

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: Sorry, but I still can't let you make your call.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: I'm begging you...

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: This isn't just one enemy.They're an organization.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: If you tell someone, the organization might find out.

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: Enemy?

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Organization?

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: I'll tell you and only you, Koichi.

dialogue.name: The_Next_Day,Sign
dialogue.speech: The Next Day

dialogue.name: Polpo
dialogue.speech: Someone gifted me a special-order pizza.

dialogue.name: Polpo
dialogue.speech: Sorry to keep you waiting. Let's see, you were...

dialogue.name: Polpo
dialogue.speech: Giorno... Giorno, uh...

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: Giorno Giovanna.

dialogue.name: Polpo
dialogue.speech: Ah, yes. Sorry about that.

dialogue.name: Polpo
dialogue.speech: My head goes blank when I eat.

dialogue.name: Polpo
dialogue.speech: Perhaps it's because all my blood goes to my stomach.

dialogue.name: Polpo
dialogue.speech: This might sound sudden, but are you a religious person, Giorno?

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: I'm not sure... but I'm not very passionate about it.

dialogue.name: Polpo
dialogue.speech: What I'm about to say may contradict God's teachings,

dialogue.name: Polpo
dialogue.speech: but I'd like you to listen carefully.

dialogue.name: Polpo
dialogue.speech: If the most important thing in this world is trust,

dialogue.name: Polpo
dialogue.speech: the most despicable thing you can do is insult someone.

dialogue.name: Polpo
dialogue.speech: Listen well... To insult or betray someone's trust

dialogue.name: Polpo
dialogue.speech: not only hurts their reputation,

dialogue.name: Polpo
dialogue.speech: but puts them in a very sticky situation.

dialogue.name: Polpo
dialogue.speech: We will not fight others or risk our lives over money, power,

dialogue.name: Polpo
dialogue.speech: or having our seats taken at a theater or on the bus.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Fighting is truly foolish.Only idiots bother with it.

dialogue.name: Polpo
dialogue.speech: But...

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: I will risk my life over being insulted.

dialogue.name: Polpo
dialogue.speech: I believe that God forgives even m*rder.

dialogue.name: Polpo
dialogue.speech: Don't forget that.

dialogue.name: Polpo
dialogue.speech: Congratulations! I will allow you to enter the organization.

dialogue.name: Polpo
dialogue.speech: You did bring me the lighter still lit, as I trusted you would.

dialogue.name: Polpo
dialogue.speech: You pass.

dialogue.name: Polpo
dialogue.speech: That's our Passione organization's badge.

dialogue.name: Polpo
dialogue.speech: It proves that you passed.

dialogue.name: Polpo
dialogue.speech: You'll be working under Bucciarati for a while.

dialogue.name: Polpo
dialogue.speech: How about it? Why don't we celebrate your...

dialogue.name: Polpo
dialogue.speech: Did that brat actually protect the flame for hours?

dialogue.name: Polpo
dialogue.speech: Or did he relight it and become a Stand user?

dialogue.name: Polpo
dialogue.speech: I couldn't care less about that.

dialogue.name: Polpo
dialogue.speech: Young, clueless guys like him are easy to use.

dialogue.name: Polpo
dialogue.speech: Either way, we can use him however we want.

dialogue.name: Polpo
dialogue.speech: Oh?

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: I could've sworn I closed that...

dialogue.name: Polpo
dialogue.speech: The blood does flow to my stomach after I've eaten...

dialogue.name: Jotaro
dialogue.speech: You met him again?

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: I'm sorry, Jotaro.

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: But I can't help thinking

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: that he, Giorno Giovanna, isn't as dangerous as you think he might be.

dialogue.name: Jotaro
dialogue.speech: What makes you think that?

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: Well...

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: Well, I'll tell you that in person.

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: Is that all right?

dialogue.name: Jotaro
dialogue.speech: All right.

dialogue.name: Jotaro
dialogue.speech: If that's what you want to do, that's fine.

dialogue.name: Jotaro
dialogue.speech: I'll be waiting.

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: Thank you.

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: I'll talk to you later.

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: Jotaro, back then, I really did think...

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: Does this Giorno kid really admire that?

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: Is he sane?

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: But I can feel it...

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: I can feel that he has a righteous heart.

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: I can tell...

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: Because I observed three members of the Joestar bloodline back in Morioh.

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: The three who exude righteousness from their hearts, as if it were their life energy.

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: I could see the same thing in his eyes.

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: Without a doubt, the blood that flows in his veins carries the will of the Joestars.

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: So I'm going to keep this to myself for a while, like he asked...

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: The golden dream that Giorno Giovanna possesses.

dialogue.name: Koichi
dialogue.speech: Well, then, maybe I'll go do some sightseeing.

dialogue.name: The_Next_Day,Sign
dialogue.speech: The Next Day

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Come with me, Giorno Giovanna.

dialogue.name: Polpo
dialogue.speech: What was that noise?

dialogue.name: Polpo
dialogue.speech: Well, whatever.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: When someone insults you, even m*rder is forgivable?

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: I see. What you told me is very important.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: You insulted that innocent old man's life.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: So I changed one of your g*ns into a banana.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: You should savor your last meal as best you can.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: So... Where are we going?

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: I'll introduce you to my team.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: They're all Stand users.
